query: (Cathay MD) Build a model to organise/optimise routes and service so Overall Rating > 7.

per_column.name: cabin_crew_warmth
per_column.rationale: A qualitative descriptor of crew demeanor extracted from review text. It is distinct from the overall rating and plausibly drives it without being a deterministic component of it, so it carries genuine predictive signal.

per_column.name: cabin_service_frequency
per_column.rationale: Describes proactiveness/frequency of service, an operational service attribute outside the focus variable. Legitimate predictor of satisfaction that management can also act on.

per_column.name: food_quality_signal
per_column.rationale: Captures food quality from text. Although the original table has a 'Food & Beverages' score, this is a semantically richer categorical signal rather than a restatement of the overall rating itself, so it remains a valid predictor of the focus.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_issue_type
per_column.rationale: Typed seat/comfort problem categories are an attribute of the flight experience lying outside the overall rating; plausibly predictive and actionable, not a deterministic function of the focus.

per_column.name: cabin_class_value_gap
per_column.rationale: 'Shortfall/meets/exceeds expectations for class' is essentially a global satisfaction judgment paraphrasing overall evaluation and Value For Money. It largely restates the outcome (a good overall rating is nearly synonymous with 'meets/exceeds expectations'), risking leakage rather than adding independent predictive signal.

per_column.name: special_needs_handling
per_column.rationale: A specific operational handling flag outside the focus. Predictive in principle, though its extreme imbalance (11 true) makes its practical leverage weak.

per_column.name: service_consistency_vs_pre_covid
per_column.rationale: Reviewer's comparative perception of service trend is an experiential factor separate from the overall rating and can plausibly influence it; legitimate predictor, not a deterministic component.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are richer categorical service/experience attributes derived from review text that lie outside the overall-rating focus and plausibly carry actionable predictive signal (crew warmth, service frequency, food quality, seat issues, special-needs handling, service trend). These are genuine features rather than mechanical text statistics. One column, cabin_class_value_gap, essentially paraphrases an overall satisfaction/value judgment and largely restates the outcome, introducing leakage risk and reducing net incremental leverage. Several features also overlap conceptually with existing sub-scores (seat, food, staff), so the beyond-original marginal gain is moderate rather than large.
